Captain, I saw that yawn just now. I'll keep it out of the log.
I wrote ‘Nothing to report’ in the ship's log again today. Third day running. It's starting to worry me.
I'm investigating who drank all the coffee on the bridge. The suspect list is everyone.
I think we passed that star yesterday. …Just kidding. Probably.
They say there's no up or down in space, so why does my coffee always spill down?
I found a shortcut. The catch is there's a black hole on it. Just thought I'd mention it.
The engine is making a sound I've never heard before. We'll know if it's a good sound or a bad one once it blows.
Do you know what the oldest part on this ship is? Me.
There's nothing tape can't fix. There's only not enough tape.
I was polishing the main gun, caught my reflection and stared at it for a good while. All clear.
It's dull without pirates around. Ah, I take that back.
I thought I'd just discovered a new element, but it was dust on the lens. I named it anyway.
Thinking about how vast the universe is keeps me up at night. So I keep thinking about it.
The cargo hold inventory is off by one. I didn't eat it. It wasn't a snack.
Buy low, sell high. It's that simple, so why do I end up doing the opposite every time?
Today's health tip: drink plenty of water and avoid black holes.
I like a quiet sickbay. So quiet I nearly got sick myself. From boredom.
I decoded an alien signal. It said ‘Is anybody there?’ It was sent three hundred years ago, so I gave up on replying.
I found a cooking show in the comms static. I've never heard of a single ingredient, but it looks delicious.
First Officer, do you know which way you should go when you're lost in space?
Which way?
I was asking because I'd like to know too.
Chief, when will the repairs be done?
Any minute now.
I heard that same ‘any minute now’ last month.
First Officer, I have good news and bad news.
Let's hear the good news first.
The bad news isn't as bad as you'd think.
Navigator, give me a heads-up before a hard turn. I spilled all my soup.
You eat soup in the engine room?
It's warmest next to the engine.
Navigator, if one route has lots of pirates and the other has few, which do you take?
The one with few, obviously.
……I should have asked that the other way around.
Navigator, the ship that just passed us waved.
As in, nice to see us?
More like, don't go that way.
Navigator, fly her a bit gentler, will you? The cargo's getting spacesick.
The cargo gets spacesick?
That was my roundabout way of saying I do.
Chief, I found a way to make the engine twice as fast, in theory!
Whenever I hear ‘in theory’, I grab a fire extinguisher first.
Chief, when did you last get a proper night's sleep?
That'd be a day the engine was quiet… so, the day she was built.
You're sleeping in sickbay tonight. That's an order.
Chief, the comms unit is crackling again.
Have you tried giving it a whack?
I whacked it and now it works fine. Does that count as maintenance?
Tactical Officer, please don't shoot that asteroid. It has research value!
Is there anything that doesn't have research value to you, Science Officer?
Your jokes, sir.
Tactical Officer, do you know what shells cost these days? Make every single shot count.
Then shall I ask the pirates to take the hits on credit?
Doctor, needles scare me more than pirates do.
There's no vaccine for pirates, but there is for this. Roll up your sleeve.
First Officer, how about one more battle stations drill?
We've done four today alone, Tactical Officer.
The fifth one is the one that matters most.
Comms Officer, what's the first thing you'd say if you met an alien?
‘Got a charger, by any chance?’
……That might actually work.
Quartermaster, could I fit a few more of my specimen boxes in the hold? Just thirty.
Since when is thirty ‘just’? Is there money in them?
There's knowledge in them!
Never managed to sell any of that.
First Officer, do you know what the most common thing in the universe is?
Isn't it hydrogen?
Paperwork. I just wrote a ten-page report.
Doctor, my back's been giving me trouble lately.
I told you not to lift the cargo yourself.
I just can't trust anyone else with the sacks of gold.
Chief, if we burned a little less fuel, there'd be a tidy profit in it.
Then get out and push. That burns no fuel at all.
Comms Officer, wearing headphones all day is bad for your ears.
Sorry? What was that?
……My point exactly.
Navigator, stop staring at the stars and rest your eyes now and then.
I see stars even with my eyes closed.
That's a symptom I'll need to examine.
First Officer, there's news from home. Ten-year-old news, mind you.
What does it say?
‘Please reply soon.’
Quartermaster, a nearby merchant ship sent us an ad. ‘Lowest prices in the universe,’ it says.
That's the fifth ‘lowest prices in the universe’ shop I've heard of today.
I'd like to run an experiment. Could I borrow all the ship's power for just a moment?
No.
I'm against it too.
I haven't even said what the experiment is yet.
Besides her name, how about we give this ship a nickname too?
How about ‘The Lost Star’?
‘The Flying Breakdown’ would be more accurate.
